quote: We conducted interviews with 15 Montrealers in early 2022. We used the PAC-LVTI sociolinguistic interview protocol to elicit detailed linguistic and sociodemographic background. This was followed by a semantic perception test in which they were shown our 40 target semantic shifts...
guideline: We asked the participants to (i) read the tweet out loud; (ii) rate the acceptability of the target word from 1 to 6; (iii) provide a contextual synonym for the target word; (iv) provide any other comments.
